status: PROPOSAL ONLY. Nothing in the database, public/parts-catalog or docs/research/aftermarket was changed. See CATALOG_PLAN.md for the load plan.
purpose: A clean motocross tire list for the parts catalog (RANKED_PLAN 3.3), plus tube, mousse and TUbliss entries, to replace the adventure, trials, dual-sport, rally and enduro tires now offered on motocross bikes.
how_to_apply: Follow docs/research/tires/CATALOG_PLAN.md: the parts catalog is static JSON built from docs/research/aftermarket by scripts/aftermarket/build_app_data.py; no SQL is involved.

Offer each tire line only in the sizes in mx_tires[].sizes, and only on bikes whose wheels take that size (wheel sizes per bike: stock tire sizes in docs/research/knowledge, or shared/tire-knowledge.ts wheelsFor()).
Hide the rows in drop_from_mx_bikes on motocross models; rows marked enduro, cross-country or desert can stay on XC, FX, TX, EX, KX-X, YZ-X and CRF-RX models.
Store position (front or rear), size and terrain as fields, not in the colour field (PARTS_AUDIT 2.3).

Give "Mousse or tube" its own entries (tubes_mousse_tubliss) on every bike; tighten the part-type regex in shared/part-types.ts, which also matches "Vent Tube Cap", "Long Vent Tube" and "Twister Tube Insert".
review_before_listing rows are motocross-looking tires not researched yet; keep or drop after checking the maker's page.
